rationale: Builds directly on the current best recurrent-tail/export path instead of restarting. I added a compact learned `tail_anchor_mix` control that refreshes the reverse-tail anchor after each recurrent block, so the carry path can keep the strong decoder-output anchor early while adapting toward the updated tail state later. This targets the still-promising reverse-tail anchor family, keeps shapes and compile behavior stable, preserves the final exact int8+zlib evaluation path, and only spends a tiny extra float budget by keeping the new control tensor in fp16 during export.
title: Reverse Tail Progressive Anchor Refresh
